title: Boundedness of module-object pushforward by truncation
statement: In [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], for every finiteness coefficient Λ, the ambient total right derived module-object pushforward sends a bounded complex with constructible homology to a bounded complex.

source.place: lem-sfb-dc-lower-star-preserves; finite cohomological devissage and bounded-below right-derived compatibility

proof.text: The inverse image of the bounded subcategory under Rf_* is triangulated and invariant under isomorphisms. For a constructible F in degree zero, left t-exactness gives lower bound zero, and the single-sheaf finiteness input supplies an upper bound. Apply finite truncation devissage to the bounded constructible input.
